target_status: Nintendo management forecast published May 8 2025; not actual sales
design_note: Ten fiscal reporting periods show the modeled rise, peak and decline; the horizon is an analyst choice, not a factual prediction of console lifetime.

base_assumptions.q: Transfer the historical primary-fit q unchanged as an analogue assumption.
base_assumptions.M: Use historical fitted M as an analogue-based hardware-volume benchmark, not an independent measurement of Switch 2 market size.
base_assumptions.p: Solve for p so that interval sales from launch to March 31 2026 match Nintendo's pre-launch 15 million-unit forecast.

scenario_note: Lower / upper cases combine source-based market-size benchmarks with omission-diagnostic q values. Recalibrate p to the same first-period target in each case. These are constructed sensitivity cases, not confidence bounds or minimum / maximum feasible sales.
